relationships.subject: TDI05
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro experiments using RAW 264.7 macrophages showed that TDI05 treatment significantly reduced AT<sub>2</sub>R expression at both the protein and mRNA levels, as determined by Western blotting and qPCR analysis, while CCK-8 assays confirmed its non-cytotoxicity.

relationships.subject: TDI05
relationships.evidence_quote: ELISA showed TDI05 reduced the production of inflammatory mediators (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-8) by RAW 264.7 cells.

relationships.subject: TDI05
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, immunofluorescence staining showed TDI05 reduced AT<sub>2</sub>R expression in sciatic nerve macrophages, while immunohistochemistry analysis confirmed suppression of TRPA1/TRPV1 expression in sensory neurons in the mouse spared nerve injury (SNI) model.

relationships.subject: TDI05
relationships.evidence_quote: In vivo validation utilizing three well-established rodent neuropathic pain models, TDI05 administration produced dose-dependent analgesic effects, significantly increasing mechanical withdrawal thresholds.

key_findings: The AT2R antagonist TDI05 reduces AT2R expression and inflammatory cytokines in macrophages and lowers TRPA1/TRPV1 expression in co-cultured neuronal cells and in SNI sensory neurons.
TDI05 produced dose-dependent analgesia in three rodent neuropathic pain models.
